integrity: The all-word claim is proved by an explicit orientation-preserving rigid rotation of the source coordinate construction. Finite coordinate and released-data checks are reported only as regression evidence and are not used to infer the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to the cited pure-square constructor with its left-right symmetric host and does not assert reversal equivalence for arbitrary braid closures. The reversal-orbit count is only an upper bound on distinct ambient-isotopy classes because additional coincidences may occur.
title: Rigid-rotation reversal theorem for a pure-braid spatial-graph family
